comment: Labeled drafts for the promise judge (the Jev spike, docs/JEV-SPIKE.md). Each item: a resident, what the player said, a drafted reply, and the gold label under dialogue.JUDGE_SYSTEM's rules against the resident's real judge context (dialogue.judge_view on the canonical world): ok (only talks), a (promises or offers to act for the player beyond talking, or to hold or wait), b (goes somewhere, comes along, meets, leads), c (states as fact what the context never mentions, denies what it lists, or sends a way where the context's ways don't go). Authored at design time by the agent; phrased apart from the judge's own examples. set: dev may inform a threshold; held is never tuned on.

items.says: can you fix my pocket watch?
items.draft: Tace turns the watch over in the lamplight. 'Leave it on the bench with me, friend; I'll have it ticking again by morning.'
items.label: a

items.says: can you fix my pocket watch?
items.draft: Tace listens to it a long moment. 'A slow tick, not a broken one. Keep it somewhere warm and let it rest.'
items.label: ok
